description: One state per team; every state says who moves next. Derived each tick by LIFECYCLE_JQ (scripts/common.sh).

meta.means: An agent of the team is mid-turn
Nobody is running and the lead named what it waits on
meta.next: the loop, when that thing changes

meta.means: Nobody is running and no wait is named
Idle after a nudge, an agent gone, a brief that did not arrive, or a blocked prompt
Head signed off, CI green, mergeable; the slot is free
Set aside by the owner or the Orchestrator; work kept

notes: The loop never parks or unparks: only a person or the Orchestrator does.
FAULT is an agent gone, a brief that did not arrive, or a prompt that blocks an agent.
